title: Austin's Water, Land, and Election Actions
summary:
*   Approved $10,000 for the operation and maintenance of the city's Water, Light & Power Plant.
*   Authorized $10,000 to compensate landowners for property flooded due to the Colorado River Dam.
*   Appointed Judges and Clerks for all seven city wards to serve two-year terms for upcoming elections.
*   Transferred funds to the Board of United Charities to support local social welfare initiatives.
